It is a heavily modified BB style pedal that is half of the celebrated Protein Pedal found on pro boards all across the world. Simple in design and avoiding the complicated options that can be found in other pedals of the same circuit, the Carbon is a pedal you might never turn off. The V2 features an additional hi-cut toggle with 2 variations, along with the OG Carbon setting. Left = Subtle Cut Center = OG Carbon Right = More Cut. Softswitching now includes an adjustable start up state. FOR INTERNATIONAL ORDERS - Please see our international dealers.
